messages:
sara: Quick thread  need a compact DP acceptance + prioritization checklist for the roadmap review. Exec asked for clear gating, a short recruitment rubric, and launch criteria. Can we sketch a working draft here?

matt: Short version: candidate scorecard, minimal integration success, feedback cadence, and an ops safety row. Keep the slide to 5 bullets max.

sara: Agreed. My rough scoring idea: three axes (impact, effort, availability). Each 1-5, threshold to invite if sum >=10 and availability >=3.

elaine: From research: partners value measurable outcomes. Suggest we require "demo of target workflow" in staging within 14 calendar days as a hard integration pass. That gives us a visible activation metric.

nora: Feedback quality matters. Require at least one structured eval per sprint (2 weeks) + one annotated transcript or 3 short notes. Use a lightweight rubric: usability, correctness, safety (0-5 each).

lex: Legal: add a single-line data handling note on the invite and SOW. For private deployments include KMS guidance and archive window (30 days) in the acceptance doc.

matt: Incentives: credits + one prioritized bug triage slot per month sounds fair. Also surface a small SLA promise for beta (non-binding): response within 48h on critical issues.

sara: Good. For launch gating propose these measurable checks:
- Recruitment pass: scorecard >=10 and signed NDA/SOW
- Integration pass: end-to-end demo in staging within 14 days
- Engagement pass: >=2 active sessions/week OR >=20 API calls/week for 3 of last 4 weeks
- Feedback pass: 1 structured eval per sprint + 2 qualitative artifacts per month
- Ops pass: runbook, incident contact, and monitoring hook; SLO P95 <= 250ms on dev traffic

elaine: Add a churn/eviction note: if engagement drops below threshold for 14 consecutive days, trigger outreach. If no recovery after 7 days notice period, archive and pause access. Rehabilitation = 2 consecutive good weeks to reinstate.

nora: For prioritization, let's require partners self-select a "primary goal" (e.g., latency, accuracy, feature match). We then tag requests as "customer-driven" if tied to a primary goal and score them higher in backlog triage.

matt: Implementation asks: need a dashboard tile to show DP cohort metrics (engagement, eval submissions, regressions). Can ops create a starter tile?

ops-bot: I can scaffold a tile. Point me at metric owners: product for sessions, infra for api_calls, evals for regressions. Templates available at /ops/templates/dp-dashboard-stub.md

lex: I'll draft the invite language including the archive/KMS blurb and a concise eviction FAQ. Keep tone collaborative.

sara: Owners recap: sara (acceptance checklist + slide), matt (scorecard + incentive briefs), nora (structured eval + rubric), lex (legal blurb + eviction FAQ), ops (dashboard tile + automation). Target: consolidate slide and scorecard by Thu EOD.

matt: Small addition: add a leading KPI for exec slide: "avg time to first successful workflow" (goal <14 days).

elaine: Also propose a qualitative KPI: partner confidence (1-10) after integration; want to see increase week-over-week.

sara: Love that. I'll assemble a one-slide artifact and link to recruitment CSV template. If folks OK, I'll push to /product/dp-acceptance-anchor.md and tag you all.

matt: :thumbsup:

nora: :thumbsup: will drop eval template by Wed

lex: :thumbsup: draft legal blurb Thursday AM

ops-bot: Deployment windows Thu 18:00 UTC; automation templates: /ops/templates/dp-onboard-mailer.md and /ops/templates/eviction-notice.md

sara: Great work. If no objections, I'll convert to slide and flag for roadmap review. Thanks team!
